raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: nebula3-python
  version: "3.8.3"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/nebula3_python-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: da4693171079e9d5efb01a579f7fb62ef7655f6169cc2ff2cbb7b7d902e2cf3d

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pdm-backend
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - future >=0.18.0
    - httplib2 >=0.20.0
    - pytz >=2021.1
    - six >=1.16.0
    - httpx >=0.22.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - nebula3
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}

about:
  summary: Python client for NebulaGraph v3
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/vesoft-inc/nebula-python

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
